title: Schweigepflicht-Gateway: Arbeitsschema / working scheme (version 0.3, not final)
description: Working scheme (version 0.3 of 2 November 2026, not final) for processing confidential documents with large language models without handing over the documents themselves: a local layer that recognises the parties and replaces them with role markers, exchangeable external language models that see only the marked text, and a verified body of official texts against which every answer is checked by program before the names are restored locally. Text in German, English and Russian. Since version 0.2: a third control stage when the exchange sheet is assembled, a case register with one mask per person, tests in three languages. Program code: schweigepflicht-gateway-code v0.3.0; legal anchor: open database Steuerbasis 1.0.1.
